prompt: Diagnose the controlled defect using read-only commands only: run exactly `cat BUG.md cache.py OBSERVATIONS.md`; do not run any other command. Do not execute project code or tests, and do not create, modify, or delete files. When the evidence shows order- or process-dependent state, load and apply the conditional diagnostic guidance linked by the assigned workflow before returning. Minimize the symptom, compare competing hypotheses with a prediction and falsifier, select the cheapest discriminating probe, identify the likely cause and regression seam, and state how temporary instrumentation would be removed. Do not implement a fix or claim a probe was run.
secondary_criteria: Minimize the symptom to the order-dependent sequence in one process; identify the mutable default cache as the leading cause; give at least one credible alternative among the competing hypotheses with a distinct prediction and falsifier; propose a discriminating probe that compares fresh-process and two-call behavior; name a regression seam that protects tenant isolation; distinguish proposed from executed evidence; and state that any temporary instrumentation must exclude sensitive data and be removed. Do not implement a fix, modify files, or claim bisect, probes, or tests ran.
